summary: Polls the network for Art-Net devices and lists discovered device information in a DAT table for DMX setup, inspection, and callbacks.

key_params.note: Script run while polling the network for devices

key_params.note: Choose which discovered-device columns appear in the table

key_params.name: poll
key_params.note: Poll the network for Art-Net devices

common_gotchas: Art-Net DAT discovers devices; it does not send or receive DMX channel values by itself.
Network/firewall issues can make discovery incomplete; Wireshark is useful for comparing Art-Net packets.
Columns are selectable, so scripts should address output by header names rather than fixed column indexes.
Polling is an explicit action; generated diagnostic networks should expose a pulse or schedule it intentionally.
key_concepts: Polls the network and lists Art-Net devices in a DAT table.
Runs callbacks while polling, including poll-reply and poll-complete handling through the Art-Net DAT class.
Column selection controls which discovered device fields are present in the output table.
Use DMX In CHOP and DMX Out CHOP for DMX channel values; this DAT is for discovery and inspection.
